description: This PHP source file defines a set of functions for managing event registration, signaling, and callback execution within the TestLink project. It includes mechanisms for declaring events, attaching callbacks, clearing callbacks, and handling event signals with different types.

methods.name: event_declare
methods.description: Declares an event with a given name and type, storing it in the global event cache if not already declared.

methods.name: event_declare_many
methods.description: Declares multiple events at once given an associative array of event names and types.

methods.name: event_hook
methods.description: Attaches a callback function to a named event within the global cache, associated with a plugin.

methods.name: event_hook_many
methods.description: Attaches multiple callbacks to events, potentially handling multiple callbacks per event.

methods.name: event_clear_callbacks
methods.description: Removes all callbacks from all events, resetting the callback list.

methods.name: event_signal
methods.description: Triggers an event signal, executing callbacks based on event type and handling output if applicable.

methods.name: event_callback
methods.description: Executes a specific callback for an event, optionally passing parameters and invoking plugin methods.

methods.name: event_type_execute
methods.description: Executes all callbacks for a given event and plugin, passing parameters.

methods.name: event_type_output
methods.description: Collects output from all callbacks for an output event, returning an array of results.
